title: Competitor timeline and buyer-signal synthesis: prioritized model-sourcing playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Synthesize competitive model-release timelines and buyer adoption signals into a prioritized playbook that product, sales, and procurement can use. Deliver a time-phased competitive timeline, a buyer-signal taxonomy (adoption triggers, procurement thresholds, risk signals), and a recommended list of 6 tactical mitigations (fallback models, pricing levers, enablement messages). The output should feed the Model Watchtower inventory and the procurement triggers dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: A consolidated competitive timeline (past 6 months + forecast 6 months) covering 12 major model vendors and 6 open model projects
Buyer-signal taxonomy documented with 5 high-signal triggers and examples from customer calls
Prioritized mitigation playbook with owner, effort estimate (T-shirt), and measurable success criteria for each action
Playbook artifact uploaded to Confluence and linked in this ticket; a 30-minute walkthrough scheduled with GTM and Platform PMs
Data sources and query notebook (notebook link) for reproducing the timeline attached

2026-03-03: Draft timeline prepared. Noticed vendor A has a likely 2Q quantized variant release that affects edge pricing — flagged as high-risk for SMB vector search use cases.

2026-03-10: Added buyer-signal taxonomy and mapped signals to internal telemetry (latency spikes, model error rate regressions, SLA breach near-misses). Preparing playbook mitigations.
2026-03-12: Internal review with Sales Ops and Procurement. Feedback: include rough procurement lead times and contract notice periods; added as columns. Ready for PM review.
Next: Incorporate PM feedback, upload final Confluence artifact, schedule 30-min walkthrough for 2026-03-18.
